intro: Between 2026-04-13 and 2026-09-30, ZCyberNews published 26 articles tagged cloud-security. Coverage spans a severity mix of 17 high, 2 critical, and 3 informational items. APT41 and PCPJack appear among the top threat actors observed. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-33413 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2026-6389 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, and CVE-2025-55182. Affected sectors include technology, government, healthcare, cloud-services, and financial services. The reporting reaches Global, EU, Israel, and North america audiences, reflecting the breadth of cloud-security incidents tracked across this period.
